subject: Forecast gate: weekly watchlist & tactical save squads
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast gate: weekly watchlist & tactical save squads

Team —

Attaching this week's priority watchlist (see attachment) and a short playbook for our "tactical save squads." I ran the numbers with Finance: we need to firm up commit for deals totaling $1.2M this cadence to hit the forecast.

Quick summary (high level):
- Red (action: save squad assignment required): Asteria Health (ACD-4879), Orion Labs (OR-213) — churn risks, contract lagging in Legal/Proc.
- Yellow (monitor / targeted unblock): BeaconMed (BM-91), Clearline (CL-34) — pricing clarifications pending.
- Green (tracking): NovaCare (NC-12) — on track post-demo.

Specific asks by EOD Wednesday (48 hrs):
1) Owners: update stage + concrete next step in the attached watchlist row for each red/yellow deal. If there is a blocker beyond your control, list owner for unblock.
2) Ben: run the constrained pricing exercise for BeaconMed and share a two-option proposal (standard / compressed discount).
3) Marcus: lead the save squad for Asteria — propose a 3-point outreach plan (technical deep-dive, procurement checklist, and exec alignment).
4) Marissa: confirm whether Asteria's legal ask (data-residency clause) can be met with our Private offering.

Notes: the watchlist includes column "confidence next 7d" — update that with % and short rationale. Finance will use these notes for the mid-week forecast update.

Attachments: 2027-05-17_watchlist_v1.xlsx; tactical-save-squad-playbook.pdf

Thanks — want a clean handoff into Wednesday's forecast call.

—Logan
Logan Wright
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast gate: weekly watchlist & tactical save squads

Thanks Logan — received and reading through. Quick updates for the watchlist row:
- Asteria Health (ACD-4879): moved from "yellow" to "amber" based on procurement timeline. Buyer is amenable to committing if Legal confirms the redline around data retention. I will loop in SE for a technical addendum.
- BeaconMed (BM-91): Buyer asked for an itemized cost deck; Ben's pricing exercise will help.

I'll fill the watchlist with % confidence and a 1-line rationale for each deal by EOD Wednesday.

Marissa
Account Executive

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast gate: weekly watchlist & tactical save squads

On it. I'll produce two options for BeaconMed by Tuesday noon — standard and compressed-discount. Planning to include token-cost sensitivity and a 30/60/90 usage ramp. Will also reach out to the SE to coordinate demo artifact delivery.

—Ben

From: procurement@asteria.health
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Asteria Health — data-residency question

Marissa —

Confirming we need a contractual clause that states data logs for production inference remain within us-east-1 and are deleted after 90 days. Can Redwood provide a redline or an addendum that references your Private offering? Also need a short matrix of available regions and KMS options to present to our security team.

If you can send a draft by Friday COB, that helps speed procurement.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
Asteria Health

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast gate: weekly watchlist & tactical save squads — status update

Morning — quick synthesis before the forecast call:
- Marcus: you're the lead on Asteria save squad. Marissa will get the Legal redline request to Procurement and SE will prepare the addendum template. Timeline: draft to Asteria by Friday COB.
- Ben: BeaconMed pricing options due Tue 12:00 PT — Finance will slot the higher-confidence number in the mid-week update.
- All owners: update the "confidence next 7d" and "next step" columns by EOD Wednesday. If anything slips to "red" after your update, flag it explicitly in the watchlist comment column.

I'll pull the updated watchlist into the forecast pack and share with Finance by Thursday morning. If anyone needs help escalating to an exec, ping me and I will join the buyer call.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we should be able to lock at least $650k of the $1.2M by next week if we execute cleanly.

—Logan
